defs.def: determined to be successful, rich, powerful, etc. 有野心的；有雄心的

ex.s: Galileo was not merely ambitious when he dropped objects of varying weights from the Leaning Tower at Pisa and timed their fall to the ground.
ex.t: 伽利略并非只是好高骛远，当他从比萨斜塔扔下重量不同的物体并计时它们落地时。

ex.s: Scientists tend to be curious and ambitious.
ex.t: 科学家倾向于好奇和雄心勃勃。

ex.s: Each generation conscientiously learnt their craft and undertook ambitious projects, many of which took years to complete.
ex.t: 每一代人都认真学习他们的工艺，并承担了雄心勃勃的项目，其中许多项目花了数年时间才完成。

ex.s: Although they shared the same ambitious and energetic approach to life, their careers unfolded in contrasting ways.
ex.t: 尽管他们对生活有着同样的雄心勃勃和充满活力的态度，但他们的职业生涯却以截然不同的方式展开。

ex.s: Most of all, don’ t be too ambitious.
ex.t: 最重要的是，不要过于雄心勃勃。

ex.s: In addition, the ambitious “Water Ten Plan” is also now tackling water pollution across the country.
ex.t: 此外，雄心勃勃的“水十大计划”目前正在全国范围内解决水污染问题。

ex.s: Example I think being ambitious in what you do is a top secret of success.
ex.t: 例如，我认为在你的工作中雄心勃勃是成功的绝密秘诀。

defs.def: needing a lot of effort, money or time to succeed 费力的；耗资的；耗时的
